bio: Miniature worlds, one centimetre at a time: dioramas of workshops, markets and kitchens, hand-built and lit by tiny lamps.
avatar: Portrait of a man in his late 30s with curly dark hair and a magnifying visor pushed up on his forehead, workshop light, wearing a leather apron, shoulders-up, photographic, fictional person
banner: Ultra-wide panoramic tilt-shift photograph of a handcrafted miniature town diorama with tiny lit windows on a workbench, subject across the middle band

collections.title: Dioramas
videos: A bakery the size of a shoebox

videos.title: A bakery the size of a shoebox
videos.description: Tiny loaves, a glowing oven and a baker figurine: a miniature Montréal bakery at work.
videos.still: Handcrafted tilt-shift miniature diorama of a tiny bakery with an oven fire glowing and a baker figurine, extremely shallow depth of field, warm soft light, no text
videos.motion: The oven fire flickers and flour dust floats slowly, the baker figurine makes a small slow gesture, subtle camera push-in, figures keep their shape.

videos.title: Night market in miniature
videos.description: Lanterns, food stalls and tiny crowds on a hand-built night market.
videos.still: Vertical handcrafted tilt-shift miniature diorama of an Asian night market with glowing paper lanterns and tiny food stalls, shallow depth of field, warm light, no text
videos.motion: Lantern lights flicker softly, steam from a tiny stall drifts upward, subtle slow tilt down, figures stay still.

videos.title: The tiny workshop, lamp on
videos.description: A miniature carpenter's workshop with a desk lamp and wood shavings on the floor.
videos.still: Handcrafted miniature diorama of a carpenter's workshop with tiny tools and wood shavings, a small desk lamp casting warm light, tilt-shift look, no text
videos.motion: The lamp light flickers slightly and wood dust floats slowly, gentle slow camera push-in.

videos.title: Rainy street, one centimetre tall
videos.description: A miniature rainy street, wet asphalt made with resin, tiny umbrellas.
videos.still: Vertical handcrafted miniature diorama of a rainy city street with tiny umbrellas, wet reflective asphalt and glowing shop windows, tilt-shift, no text
videos.motion: Rain droplets shimmer and reflections ripple on the wet street, slow gentle tilt-up along the street.

stories.caption: Paint still wet
stories.still: Vertical close-up photograph of a hand painting a tiny brick wall on a miniature building with a fine brush, magnifier lamp light, no face, no text

stories.still: Vertical macro photograph of a miniature loaf of bread next to a coin for scale on a workbench, no text

stories.still: Vertical tilt-shift photograph of a miniature street at dusk with tiny glowing windows, no text
